name: FYIcons

source.scope: Complete Icons section inventory, including component-set variants. All 1038 eligible 16 × 16 SVG exports verified against live Figma SHA-256 checksums. duplicatePolicy: Distinct icons with the same base name receive numeric suffixes to disambiguate the current inventory; suffixes may change when the inventory changes.
